findings: The complete MM source preserves four grass strokes and a continuous central horizontal stroke; no cross-component contact is newly introduced in the public proof.

Publisher body H13 extends across both inner verticals, and V15/V16 connect the upper and lower body horizontals. In this MM source H13 is short, and V15/V16 cross middle H14 without reaching upper H13. The full-source relative placement differs; individual stroke stretching is not approved.
Slanted and curved MM strokes also differ from the publisher font. Exact-font identity is not claimed. Additional source evidence is needed before accepting the internal structural variation.
decision: HOLD; partial static review only, not all nineteen mapped strokes or temporal playback
